rows.name: Agent
rows.focus: Agent arena: models scored from agentic coding/task sessions (score, not Elo; with cost and tokens per task).
rows.metrics: quality*, cost*, tokens*, uncertainty*, effort*, date*, breakdown*, votes*, other*
rows.metrics_detail:
Quality [data]: score (IPS score) — aggregate agent score as a fraction (e.g. 0.274), not a Bradley-Terry rating · https://huggingface.co/datasets/lmarena-ai/leaderboard-dataset/resolve/main/agent/latest-00000-of-00001.parquet
Quality [data]: index_score / raw_score — per-signal subsets (agent_capability, agent_task_outcome, agent_task_outcome_explicit, agent_tool_efficiency, agent_tool_hallucination, agent_steerability, agent_praise_complaint, agent_bash_reliability, agent_bash_recovery_steps)
rows.notes: arena.ai (lmarena.ai redirects there) returns Cloudflare 403 to automated fetches, so the page itself could not be read; URL taken from the official sitemap (https://arena.ai/sitemap.xml), values from the official LMArena leaderboard dataset (latest split) config 'agent', category 'overall'. Ratings rounded to integer. Publish date 2026-11-22. Score is a 0-1 value as stored (site display format unverified). Dataset also has agent_* sub-metric configs (task_outcome, steerability, tool_efficiency, tool_hallucination, bash_reliability, ...).
rows.difficulty_detail: Cannot be levelled: Agent Arena uses IPS scores (τ̂), per the official dataset card: a relative signal estimate that ranges below 0, not a 0-100 share of tasks solved; no conversion to task success exists.

rows.name: WB-Score
rows.focus: Individual checklist-based score of each response (task-macro average across task categories).
rows.metrics_detail:
Quality [page]: 💯 Score — WB-Score, checklist-based individual score by LLM judge, task-macro average (0-100) · https://huggingface.co/spaces/allenai/WildBench/raw/main/constants.py
Breakdown [page]: 📝 Creative / 💭 Reason & Plan / 📊 Math & Data / ℹ️ Info Seek / 💻 Code & Debug — WB-Score per task category, shown as columns of the 📊 Main tab · https://huggingface.co/spaces/allenai/WildBench/raw/main/app.py
Breakdown [data]: WB_score.original_task=<11 task types> — finer task-type scores · https://
rows.notes: Gradio space; values from the data file the space loads (K=∞ / -1), names from model_info.json pretty_name, rounded to 1 decimal as the app does. Leaderboard data last changed mid-2024 (space last modified 2024-08-06; GitHub repo last commit 2024-08-01); newer models are not included. 🚨 marks models flagged new on the board. Ranking column is WB_score.task_macro ('💯 Score '). Plain average WB_score: Athene-70B 🚨 59.4, gpt-4o-2024-05-13 58.8, gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 🚨 57.3.
rows.difficulty_detail: Cannot be levelled: WB-Score is an LLM-judge checklist rating: GPT-4-Turbo gives each response 1-10, the paper rescales it as S'=(S-5)x2 and averages (so -8..10; the board shows it x10, e.g. 59.3), 0 = 'borderline acceptable'. It is linearly convertible to the mean 1-10 judge score, but it is not a share of tasks solved, so it is not a valid input to a task-success difficulty fit.

rows.notes: Gradio space; values from the data file the space loads (K=∞ / -1), names from model_info.json pretty_name, rounded to 1 decimal as the app does. Leaderboard data last changed mid-2024 (space last modified 2024-08-06; GitHub repo last commit 2024-08-01); newer models are not included. 🚨 marks models flagged new on the board. Task column on Main tab.
rows.difficulty_detail: Cannot be levelled: Per-category WB-Score: same judge-rating scale as 18.3, not a share of tasks solved. WB-Score is an LLM-judge checklist rating: GPT-4-Turbo gives each response 1-10, the paper rescales it as S'=(S-5)x2 and averages (so -8..10; the board shows it x10, e.g. 59.3), 0 = 'borderline acceptable'. It is linearly convertible to the mean 1-10 judge score, but it is not a share of tasks solved, so it is not a valid input to a task-success difficulty fit.

rows.name: GSM8K (main) — test split
rows.focus: Grade school math word problems taking 2-8 steps of elementary arithmetic; solutions use calculation annotations and end with the final answer after '####'.
rows.metrics_detail:
Quality [paper]: Test Solve Rate (%) — % of the 1K test problems solved; figures only (Figs 2, 3, 5-8) · https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.14168
Uncertainty [paper]: standard deviation across 3 runs — Figures 2 and 5 · https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.14168
Runs [paper]: test@1 / test@100 and 3 runs — test@N solved by at least one of N samples (Fig 3); mean over 3 runs (175B verification single run) · https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.14168
Effort [paper]: Finetuning vs Verification — separate results per method; F
rows.notes: No official leaderboard: repo is archived ('Archive... no updates expected'); results exist only in the paper (arXiv 2110.14168, 2021: GPT-3 finetuning vs verification baselines). Leaderboards elsewhere are third-party. 1,319 test problems (README says '1K'); the evaluation split. Also HF config 'main', split 'test' at https://huggingface.co/datasets/openai/gsm8k.
rows.difficulty_detail:
Fitted level L1 (Basic); bootstrap agreement: L1 100%.
Placed from 8 models' published scores — only models on one side of its difficulty were tested, so this is a bound.
Best observed: OrcaCyber-Nano-1.0 97.5, Ternary Bonsai 2 27B 96.7, Llama-3.1-70B 95.1.
Official difficulty: 'A bright middle school student should be able to solve every problem'; 2-8 steps (README).

Runs [paper]: pass@k (1/10/100) / 100 samples per problem — abstract: 70.2% solved with 100 samples per problem; harness skips pass@k when fewer than k samples · https://arxiv.org/abs/2107.03374
Not reported: cost, time, speed, tokens, uncertainty, effort, date, breakdown, votes
Note: The official human-eval repo publishes n
rows.notes: Repo is the only dataset it defines (164 problems; no variants/splits). Repo marked 'Deprecated and unmaintained'; no leaderboard. Paper (2021) reports Codex 28.8% (pass@1), GPT-J 11.4%, GPT-3 0%; 70.2% with 100 samples.
